text.name: Smeargle

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Portrait
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Smeargle is your Active Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. If you do, choose a Supporter card you find there and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. This power can't be used if Smeargle is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to leave its own footprints as art on rock.

text.name: Shaymin

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Celebration Wind
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Shaymin from your hand onto your Bench, you may move as many Energy cards attached to your Pokémon as you like to any of your other Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Bloom
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it.

text.flavor: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

attacks.name: X Ball
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon and the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psydrive
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Dark Cloak
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any {Darkness} Energy attached to it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Night Spear
attacks.text: Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: Pokémon-EX rule
rules.text: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Dual Ball
effect: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Terrakion

attacks.name: Retaliate
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during his or her last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

text.flavor: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

text.name: Junk Arm
effect: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. You can't choose Junk Arm with the effect of this card.

text.name: Eviolite
effect: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is a Basic Pokémon, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.label: Pokémon Tool
rules.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Dark Patch
effect: Attach a basic {Darkness} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched {Darkness} Pokémon.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Prism Energy
effect: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is a Basic Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.

text.name: Pokémon Catcher
effect: Switch your opponent's Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: N
effect: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player draws a card for each of his or her remaining Prize cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: PlusPower
effect: During this turn, your Pokémon's attacks do 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Professor Juniper
effect: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Random Receiver
effect: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a Supporter card. Put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Professor Oak's New Theory
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Ultra Ball
effect: Discard 2 cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 cards, you can't play this card.) Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Super Scoop Up
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Switch
effect: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
